title: Turkey Cranberry Fried Rice
steps:
Warm the turkey in a
hot oiled skillet
to 165°F

Add ginger, then veggies
and cranberries.
3 minutes

Stir in hot rice
+ 3 tbsp soy sauce.
Top with green onion
vo: Leftover turkey in the fridge? Turn it into fried rice tonight.
You need two to three cups of chopped leftover turkey, two pouches of microwave rice, frozen stir-fry vegetables, dried cranberries, soy sauce, fresh ginger and green onions.
Heat oil in a big skillet and warm the chopped turkey until it reaches one sixty-five degrees.
Add grated ginger, then the frozen vegetables and cranberries, and cook three minutes.
Microwave the rice, stir it in with three tablespoons of soy sauce, and top with green onions.
